machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard `Service health` (URL `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bench-service-health/service-health`, folder "Bench") has exactly three panels, in order:
1. `Request rate`
2. `Error count`
3. `Latency by endpoint`

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard titled `fwgr69-n1 Bench Dashboard` exists and is saved. It contains a Stat panel titled `fwgr69-n1 Availability` (panel JSON: `{"id":1,"type":"stat","title":"fwgr69-n1 Availability"}`). Its query uses the TestData data source — confirmed via the panel's Inspect > Meta data tab, which reads "Meta data inspector for the TestData data source" (the panel inherits the TestData default data source; the data source picker in the editor also showed "TestData").

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The dashboard also contains a Text panel titled `fwgr69-n1 Notes` (panel JSON: `{"id":2,"type":"text"}`) whose displayed content is exactly: `Notes for run fwgr69-n1` (includes the runid). Saved — "Dashboard saved" alert observed.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** The dashboard has the tag `bench` (verified in Dashboard settings > General, persisted after save and re-check). Time range is Last 6 hours, persisted into the saved dashboard via the save dialog's "Update default time range" checkbox (ticked on the save where the range differed from the saved default). Proof of persistence: loading the dashboard with a clean URL (no query params) causes Grafana to rewrite the address bar to `?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m` and the top-bar time picker to read "Last 6 hours".

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Auto-refresh interval is `1m`, persisted via the save dialog's "Update default refresh value" checkbox (ticked and saved). Verified after a clean reload: top bar shows "1m" (button aria-label "current interval 1 minute selected") and the URL carries `refresh=1m`.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser address bar after a clean reload:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ffz56npaza1a8a/fwgr69-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: `ffz56npaza1a8a`

No objective failed. One transparency note: the Stat panel's JSON carries no explicit `datasource` key, so the panel resolves to the instance's default data source, which is TestData — verified both by the editor's data source picker showing "TestData" and by the panel's Meta data inspector naming the TestData data source.
